blocks.text: The original review inspected the site at commit 29f9232545aa112cd6ffa9fe1f3c0e85d093dedd. Its substantive findings concern alternating-tower convergence, the sharp envelope and two-base classification, the logistic quarter-turn, and prime-polynomial counting. The complete arguments are now available in the separate notes linked on this document’s opening page; their original source references remain pinned.

rows: Factor the second iterate; calculate the multiplier and the defined paired matrix; evaluate the fourth-return displacement derivative at the cycle points.
Map into a closed invariant interval and apply a uniform contraction bound to obtain existence, uniqueness and convergence.
Use v log v = t exp(−t), its maximum and its two inverse branches to classify every admissible upper height.
